caption: The drawing features a metallic object resembling a key, vertically oriented with intricate details and ornamentation. At the top of the key is a sculpted bird, positioned horizontally and facing to the right, with its wings partially spread and a rounded, dome-like element situated on its back. Below and to the right of the bird, there is a larger, semi-spherical dome attached to the horizontal segment of the key's shaft, which is decorated with a pattern of leaves and other embellishments. The main shaft of the key is vertically grooved, ending in a quatrefoil-shaped bow with four rounded clover-like cutouts. The colors used are predominantly shades of gray, silver, and brown, which give the appearance of metal with areas of sheen and shading to suggest volume and material texture. The composition is enclosed within a rectangular border on a light, neutral background.
title: Sewing Bird
